scenarios.setup: Agent proposes a batch against revision N; a user edit bumps the board to N+1 before apply.
scenarios.expectation: approval rejected as stale; displayed board matches persisted board

scenarios.setup: Agent reads shape S at revision N, then targets S after another actor changed it.
Two agent operations target the same shape concurrently.
scenarios.expectation: exactly one applied; second rejected as stale

scenarios.setup: An already-applied operation is replayed verbatim.
scenarios.expectation: replay classified as duplicate; no second mutation

scenarios.setup: An operation carrying boardId B is applied while board A is active.
Mutation is persisted but the process stops before broadcasting.
scenarios.expectation: reconnect loads persisted state; no lost acknowledged write

scenarios.setup: Client disconnects, several mutations occur, then it reconnects.
scenarios.expectation: displayed canvas equals persisted state; no duplicate application
